label: PF Backlog 562
title: Orchestrator UI: small CI/CD view over the engineering ci-cd API (gates x tiers x status)
body:
## Goal & value
A small orchestrator UI view that renders the CI/CD + gates model from the read API (BI-PF-1239), so an
operator can see the pipeline, gates, owners and last verdict for `product_forge` and each generated product.

## In scope (UI; consumes the API - adds none)
- Read `GET /api/v1/engineering/ci-cd`, `/ci-cd/{scope}`, `/gates`.
- Show: tiers x gates (catalog), owners, counts, and the last run verdict/evidence per scope.
- Scope switcher (product_forge | project:<id>); `not_built` state for un-built products.

## Out of scope
- The API/model itself (BI-PF-1239, done) and any gate behaviour change.
- The legacy dashboard scope (excluded; see config/pf-review-scope.json).

## Acceptance (G/W/T)
- Given the endpoints return data, when the view loads, then gates/tiers/owners + last verdict render per scope.
- Given a `project` scope with no repo, then the view shows the explicit `not_built` state (no error).
- Read-only: the view never mutates state.

## Dependencies & links (by id)
Consumes BI-PF-1239 (API). Epic BI-PF-1243. Model: docs/CI-CD-AND-GATES-SSOT.md (Part D).

## Note
Deferred - "we will do it later" (recorded now so it is not lost).
